entry.id: urn:research-bot:agent-评测与欺骗能力基准欺骗可纠正性:finding:anthropic-在-2025-年-10-月发布了开放的-agent-skill-规范skillmd-格式九个月后-github-公开仓库已积累数百万个-skill-文件形成去中心化的技能复用生态
entry.title: Anthropic 在 2025 年 10 月发布了开放的 Agent Skill 规范（SKILL.md 格式），九个月后 GitHub 公开仓库已积累数百万个 skill 文件，形成去中心化的技能复用生态。
entry.summary: Anthropic introduced the format in October 2025 as an open specification. Nine months later, public GitHub repositories hold millions of skill files. Skills have no central registry or package manager; developers reuse them by copying folders between repositories.

entry.title: 开发者在构建和维护 AI Agent 系统时面临反复出现的工程困难，包括规划、工具使用、记忆、目标导向行动等核心能力的集成与调试问题。
entry.summary: Empirical study on Stack Overflow & GitHub Issues analyzing developer discussions and failure reports from widely used Agent frameworks. Latent themes derived via LDA-MALLET and manually validated.
